checks_performed: Verified the offset calculation logic against 1-based pagination requirements.
direct.conclusion: The page-2 failure is caused by an off-by-one offset calculation defect: `offset = page * page_size`. For one-based page numbers, this skips the entire second page of records (offsetting by 2 * page_size on page 2 instead of 1 * page_size). The corrected expression is `offset = (page - 1) * page_size`.
